implementation_plan: Replace the client-only root redirect and add the missing blog heading, then validate rendered metadata, headings, sitemap membership, and lastmod coverage.
Persist upstream sidebar ordering and make grid-only recovery run the same relevant finalizers as full ingest, then prove full-corpus byte equivalence.
Replace random installer control IDs with React useId and prove uniqueness, label binding, repeatable SSR, and hydration stability.
Expand the rendered-link gate to same-host HTTP links and terminal-wildcard redirect sources, then pin parser boundaries with mutations.
Run all Learn and exact-source tests, two byte-identical production builds, rendered audits, provenance checks, and repository hygiene checks.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: The root route is a useful server-rendered landing page with accurate metadata and exactly one H1, remains sitemap-eligible, and the functional blog page has exactly one H1 while remaining sitemap-excluded.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: The sitemap contains 1968 URLs with lastmod on every URL; the root and blog render one H1 each.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Grid-only recovery loads the committed map ordering and runs the same applicable finalizers as full ingest.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Grid-only recovery is byte-equivalent for all generated grid files to the grid subset from a full ingest using identical inputs, and repeated recovery is a fixed point.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: One-line installer controls use React's server-stable ID mechanism and preserve unique label bindings across repeated instances.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Repeated same-method instances have unique bound IDs, server rendering is repeatable, and two unchanged production builds are byte-identical.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: The rendered-link gate rejects exact and terminal-wildcard Netlify redirect sources, including same-host HTTP links; unquoted href attributes remain outside the parser because Docusaurus emits quoted attributes.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Current rendered output has no redirect-source links and regression mutations cover exact, encoded, terminal-wildcard, HTTP, slash, and quoted-attribute boundaries.
